blocking_items: HF8_WEIGHT_ARTIFACT_GATE remains HOLD; no real promoted weight artifact exists.
No Hugging Face Space UI/API contract has been validated.
Concurrent-session state isolation has not been validated.
Checkpoint persistence across Space restart/rebuild has not been validated.
External durable checkpoint/state storage has not been bound and verified.
Secrets handling and read/write authority boundaries inside a Space have not been validated.
GPU/CUDA parity is not required for an initial CPU Space, but remains unvalidated.
exit_criteria: Choose an explicit Space surface: static inspector, Gradio CPU, or Docker CPU/GPU.
Bind the Space to an exact source commit and dependency lock.
Validate session isolation and request concurrency semantics.
Use external durable storage for mutable checkpoints/state; do not treat ephemeral Space disk as canonical.
Verify restart/rebuild recovery from the external durable state.
Validate secrets and least-privilege write scope.
If the Space executes model inference, bind a real verified weight artifact or explicitly define a no-weight diagnostic mode.
Produce a remote Space receipt and require a separate human promotion for production designation.
